results.reason: Article 29: competent minister and municipal/provincial heads may designate national/public/private medical facilities; the designated institution must furnish the four enumerated services on request; the Presidential Decree governs designation and expenses. Correction correctly distinguishes designated facility from generic medical center and retains all four services.

Article 31: return-home support, not compulsory deportation; state/local governments may operate return programs for foreign victims, Justice Minister can request consular assistance for Korean victims abroad and consulates must cooperate absent special reason; costs and procedure preserved.

Article 33: state/local government authority, designation of privately operated support facilities, all five types, and exact duration caps (one year plus 18 months, two years until recovery, until age 19 plus two years, three months subject to Article 43, and two years plus two years) checked. Correction fixes support-facility terminology, victim recovery rather than damages, and state/local-government subject.
